questions.question: What is Data Science?
questions.ideal_answer: Data Science is the field of extracting useful insights, patterns, and knowledge from structured and unstructured data using statistics, machine learning, and data visualization.

questions.question: What is Data Cleaning?
questions.ideal_answer: Data cleaning is the process of removing errors, duplicates, inconsistencies, and missing values from datasets to improve data quality.

questions.question: Difference between structured and unstructured data?
questions.ideal_answer: Structured data follows a predefined format such as tables and databases, while unstructured data includes text, images, videos, and audio files.

questions.question: What is Correlation?
questions.ideal_answer: Correlation measures the strength and direction of the relationship between two variables.

questions.question: What is Data Visualization?
questions.ideal_answer: Data visualization represents information using charts, graphs, and dashboards to make insights easier to understand.

questions.question: Explain Hypothesis Testing.
questions.ideal_answer: Hypothesis testing is a statistical method used to determine whether there is enough evidence to support a specific claim about data.

questions.question: What is Standard Deviation?
questions.ideal_answer: Standard deviation measures how spread out data values are from the mean.

questions.question: Difference between Mean and Median?
questions.ideal_answer: Mean is the average value, while median is the middle value after sorting the dataset.

questions.question: Explain Regression Analysis.
questions.ideal_answer: Regression analysis identifies relationships between variables and predicts future outcomes.

questions.question: What is Feature Engineering?
questions.ideal_answer: Feature engineering involves creating, selecting, or transforming features to improve model performance.

questions.question: How would you build a churn prediction model?
questions.ideal_answer: Collect customer data, preprocess it, train classification models, evaluate performance, and deploy the best model.

questions.question: Explain A/B Testing.
questions.ideal_answer: A/B testing compares two versions of a product or feature to determine which performs better.

questions.question: How would you handle missing data?
questions.ideal_answer: Missing values can be removed, replaced using statistical methods, or predicted using machine learning techniques.

questions.question: What is Dimensionality Reduction?
questions.ideal_answer: Dimensionality reduction decreases the number of features while preserving important information.

questions.question: Explain PCA.
questions.ideal_answer: Principal Component Analysis reduces dataset dimensions while retaining maximum variance.
